title: DoltLite brings Git-style history and sync to SQLite
friendlyTitle: DoltLite adds version history to SQLite databases
summary: DoltLite has entered beta with a stable storage format, broad SQLite compatibility and Git-like branching, merging, diffs, push and pull. DoltHub says the project was built through about 2,000 agent-assisted pull requests and now passes 100% of sqllogictest's 5.8 million queries.
friendlySummary: DoltLite is a new SQLite-based database that can branch, compare, merge and sync data like Git. It has reached beta after extensive testing.
whyItMatters: Versioned local data can make AI-assisted applications easier to inspect, synchronize and recover when an automated change goes wrong. The trade-off is measurable write overhead, so teams should benchmark their own workload and favour batched writes.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Apps and AI agents can make mistakes. Database history makes it easier to see what changed and return to an earlier version.
